text:
alex: From the postmortem (inc-512) — please confirm owners and final due dates for the action items below. I will update the action tracker once you ack or reassign.
- A1: Harden routing fallback (owner: kyle) due 2025-09-30
- A2: Add canary to autoscaler config (owner: maria) due 2025-09-28
- A3: Update runbook with cutover and rollback steps (owner: sam) due 2025-09-29
- A4: Fix config drift detection job (owner: taylor) due 2025-10-02

Please reply with "ack" or "reassign -> @name + new due". If someone needs help, shout out and we can split tasks. Thanks :wave:

kyle: ack. Quick note — I'm on PTO 2025-09-29 -> 2025-10-01. Can shift A1 to 2025-10-05 if that's okay.

maria: ack for A2. I can do a canary by 09/28 but will need a short CR review from infra. @sam can you review? :pray:

sam: I can review A2 CR today. For A3, I need a little help documenting the rollback steps — @taylor can you add the exact config names that change during cutover? I'll draft the runbook text.

taylor: reassign -> @sam for A4? I'm tied up with a perf incident rollback early next week. If @sam takes A4 I can support reviews. New proposed due for A4 if reassigned: 2025-10-04.

sam: OK I can take A4 (config drift job). Will open a PR and link it here.

ops-bot: IncidentBot created action items in tracker: https://tracker.internal/actions/INC-512 (A1..A4) :white_check_mark:

kyle: reassign -> @sam for A1 as well? I can still help pair for the fallback tests but can't own while on PTO. If @sam takes A1, propose due 2025-10-06.

sam: taking A1 and A4. Setting new dues: A1 2025-10-06, A4 2025-10-04. I'll open PRs and ping for reviews.

maria: pinging again for infra CR review on A2 — @jess (ptl) can we slot a 15m review tomorrow morning? If not, I can queue it for afternoon.

jess: happy to review at 09:30 PST tomorrow. Add me to the PR and I'll do the quick pass.

alex: nice — summary updated. Small checklist for owners:
```
- open PR and link in tracker
- add one-line QA steps in the PR description
- @mention oncall if changes touch routing or autoscaler
```

sam: PR for A4 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2371 — includes tests and runbook snippet. Requesting review from @taylor and @jess.

maria: PR for A2 ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autoscaler/pull/489 — assigned to @sam and @jess.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check-in in #incidents on 2025-10-07.

jess: ack. I'll mark the tracker once reviews merge and tests pass. Thanks everyone.

alex: thanks — I'm closing this slack thread. If anyone reassigns further, please post the new owner + due and I'll update the tracker manually. :thumbsup:
